task_description: Add automatic WiFi chip detection with optimal monitor mode configuration, enhanced monitor mode lifecycle management with auto-cleanup, and tshark decryption integration for live protocol analysis during recon.

Now uses build_decrypt_args() inline approach directly with log.warning about PSK process listing visibility.
